name: Net-liquidity impulse regime — long crypto beta only when net-liquidity RoC is positive AND accelerating (daily)
rationale: MECHANISM: the durable edge is the CHANGE in net liquidity (WALCL-TGA) leading crypto beta, NOT the decaying level correlation. When reserves expand they get levered into the far end of the risk curve; crypto absorbs the marginal dollar last and hardest (~7.6x amplification per CrossBorder/Howell). The counterparty is macro/rates desks on a slow institutional clock (mandate + committee lags) while 24/7 retail-heavy crypto front-runs the same plumbing. Trade: gate BTC/ETH-beta longs on net_liquidity_usd 4-8w rate-of-change being positive AND the crypto tape confirming momentum (positive medium-term ret_Nd). DISCONFIRMER: net_liquidity_usd is WEEKLY with a conservative available_at = ts+8 days, so by the time the signal is PIT-legal the 1-2w lead is largely consumed — kill if the T+8-lagged series' OOS Sharpe net of fees is indistinguishable from naive BTC buy-and-hold, or if the edge only exists pre-2024 (RRP is empty in 2026, the mechanical pump is gone).
catalyst: positive, accelerating net-liquidity impulse into a confirming crypto uptrend
